fact: Tchadinfos reports the finance ministry signed partnership conventions with Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi, and the minister said they cover settling the salaries of all civil servants.

Chad's finance ministry signed a five-year non-exclusive framework convention with Moov Money, Airtel Money, Konoom and Cashi-Tchad that lets the State pay salaries, bonuses or pensions through mobile money, and the finance minister said every civil servant could receive salary free by bank or mobile wallet.

The Cellule Filets sociaux coordinator said the government safety-net cash transfers are paid through two mechanisms, contracts with microfinance institutions and with mobile telephone operators, while in Bahr El Gazal the agency Express Union pays the transfer in cash.
